Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Stephen Cox
Message:
refactor: collapse 51 packages into 3 profile-shaped mega-packages

Replaces the flat 51-package layout with three composable, profile-named
packages that match how dotfiles are actually deployed across machines:

  shell/      portable shell environment (zsh + integrations, gh, tpm,
              gnupg/.ssh/.docker, password-store tooling, audio/player/
              bluetooth helpers, font assets)
  desktop/    Linux X11 desktop stack (bspwm + bsp + sxhkd, polybar,
              picom, dunst, gtk 2/3/4, palette, themes, backgrounds,
              icons, plus the X-session boot logic in .zlogin.d/)
  optional/   per-host opt-ins (claude, neofetch, ranger, rofi,
              alacritty, ad-hoc tools)

A fresh machine bootstraps with one stow command per profile:

  Server:        stow shell
  Linux desktop: stow shell desktop
  Workstation:   stow shell desktop optional

The 51 -> 3 collapse drops 595 path-tracked files of cross-package
plumbing while preserving every shell integration (zsh-autosuggestions,
zsh-syntax-highlighting, fzf-tab, fzf shell integration, dircolors,
all 50-* per-tool hooks, starship prompt). Desktop X-session launchers
(polybar, picom, dunst, polkit, sxhkd, feh) move to
desktop/.config/zsh/.zlogin.d/ so they only fire when desktop is stowed.

The dotfiles install/uninstall script is updated with the err/warn/info/
ok helpers and the expanded .ignore regex (README, LICENSE, .git*,
.DS_Store) so it walks the new layout cleanly.

Submodule manifest update (.gitmodules) follows in a separate commit.
